trials.claim: Lifetime access to PDF Reader Pro for Windows Plan, not for Mac
trials.claimQuote: Lifetime access to PDF Reader Pro for Windows Plan (Not for Mac)
trials.reasoning: Buyers report the AppSumo code no longer unlocks the full product and redirects to a trial, and that they are repeatedly logged out and asked to pay again after paying.

exhibits.quote: Features locked after recent update. I can't access the full product anymore with the AppSumo code; the license retrieval process doesn't work and it just sends me to a free seven-day trial.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports lifetime code no longer unlocks full product and redirects to trial, contradicting lifetime access.

exhibits.quote: Keeps loggin me out and asking me to payup again and again. even afer payi ng $59 i keep getting logged out and asked to pay again!
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports being asked to pay again after paying, undermining lifetime access.

exhibits.quote: We provide multiple plans, including a Yearly Subscription Plan and a Permanent Plan.
exhibits.argument: A Permanent Plan on the vendor site supports lifetime access rather than subscription only.

exhibits.quote: PDF Reader Pro for Mac PDF Reader Pro for Windows PDF Reader Pro for iPhone/iPad PDF Reader Pro for Android PDF Reader Pro Web New
exhibits.argument: Vendor lists Windows and Mac as separate products, supporting Windows-only scope.

trials.claim: All future updates to the PDF Reader Pro for Windows Plan are included
trials.claimQuote: All future PDF Reader Pro for Windows Plan updates
trials.reasoning: A buyer reports features were locked after a recent update and the lifetime code only led to a free seven-day trial, contradicting included future updates.

exhibits.quote: Features locked after recent update. I can't access the full product anymore with the AppSumo code; the license retrieval process doesn't work and it just sends me to a free seven-day trial.
exhibits.argument: Update locked features for lifetime holder, contradicting that all future updates are included.

trials.claim: The regular price was $79.99 and the deal price is $59.99
trials.reasoning: The exhibit only mentions a buyer paying $59, with no evidence shown for the claimed $79.99 regular price or the exact $59.99 deal price.

exhibits.quote: even afer payi ng $59 i keep getting logged out and asked to pay again!
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms paying $59, supporting the claimed deal price.

trials.claim: All-in-one PDF office to read, edit, annotate, convert, create, OCR, fill forms and sign PDFs
trials.claimQuote: All-in-one PDF office to read, edit, annotate, convert, create, OCR, fill forms and sign PDFs.
trials.reasoning: Two buyers report half the advertised features do not work or are paywalled and that included signing was inaccessible, outweighing the single positive review and vendor description.

exhibits.quote: False advertising and near impossible to register it at all. Half the advertised features dont work and you're hit by a paywall for almost everything.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports half the advertised features do not work and are paywalled, contradicting all-in-one claim.

exhibits.quote: It's been impossible to activate my license because the key numbers they gave me didn't work. I don't have access to key features of the app that were included in my package, like signing documents.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports no access to included signing feature due to failed activation, undermining all-in-one functionality.

exhibits.quote: Streamline document workflow and unleash productivity with our PDF Solution - effortlessly view, edit, convert, annotate, and form-fill PDF files across Mac, Windows, Web, iOS, and Android.
exhibits.argument: Vendor describes an all-in-one solution covering view, edit, convert, annotate and form-fill.

exhibits.quote: You can edit the document, combine files, extract files, number pages, add watermarks, protect files, add digital signatures etc.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms multiple editing, organizing and signing functions work as promised.

trials.claim: Recognize texts from image-based or scanned PDF with OCR
trials.claimQuote: Recognize texts from image-based or scanned PDF with OCR
trials.reasoning: The vendor states scanned files and images become fully editable with accurate text recognition and image-based files become searchable PDFs, directly supporting OCR.

exhibits.quote: Turn scanned files and images into fully editable PDFs with accurate text recognition and preserved layout.
exhibits.argument: Vendor states scanned files and images become editable via accurate text recognition.

exhibits.quote: Transform static image-based files into searchable PDFs for information retrieval.
exhibits.argument: Vendor states image-based files become searchable PDFs, supporting OCR recognition.

trials.claim: Multi-tab viewer and split view to compare files
trials.claimQuote: Multi-tab Viewer & Split View to compare file
trials.reasoning: No exhibit mentions a multi-tab viewer or split view; the comparison exhibit only mentions comparing PDFs generally and the crash report does not address those features.

exhibits.quote: Nice features but unstable. The program is generally easy to use, and has plenty of features. That said, it crashes periodically and needs to be restarted…losing all unsaved edits on my Window 11 I-9 pc w 64gb ram/10tb ssd
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports periodic crashes losing edits, undermining reliable viewer use for comparing files.

exhibits.quote: Compare PDFs, spot every difference instantly, and generate change summaries.
exhibits.argument: Vendor advertises PDF comparison with difference detection and change summaries.
